why: The 32,000 budget was chosen without evidence. These are the first real measurements, taken after the response usage began to be logged on every call rather than only on failures.

conclusion.verdict: 32,000 is sufficient for these three legs, with roughly 2.6x margin over the worst observed run.
conclusion.whyItFailedBefore: The previous 12,000 cap sat inside the observed range, so the same route exceeded it on one run and not on another. A cap set within the natural variance of what it caps fails intermittently and looks mysterious each time.
conclusion.caveat: Four runs, one provider, one model, three routes. Enough to justify 32,000 and to explain the old failure; not enough to characterise the tail. Keep the logging on.
